info.title: Cafe Poppy table booking
info.description:
Request a table at Cafe Poppy. No sign-in.

How it works:
1. POST /bookings with the diner's details. The answer has a `confirm_code` and a `confirm_url` (a WhatsApp link).
2. The diner opens `confirm_url` and sends the prefilled message from THE SAME phone number as `phone`, within 30 minutes (`expires_at`).
   Until then the request is not sent to the restaurant. A code sent from another number does nothing.
3. The restaurant then accepts or declines it, and tells the diner on WhatsApp.
   Poll GET /bookings/{booking_id} with the `X-Booking-Status-Token` header to follow it.

At most 3 unconfirmed requests per phone number at a time. Send an Idempotency-Key header to retry safely.

Collection statement: The details you submit (date, time, party size, name, phone number and notes) go only to Cafe Poppy, to handle this booking. Privacy policy: https://ohmyclient.io/privacy-policy.html
收集個人資料聲明: 你提交的資料(日期、時間、人數、姓名、電話號碼及備註)只會交給Cafe Poppy,用作處理今次訂座。 私隱政策: https://ohmyclient.io/privacy-policy.html

post.description: Creates a booking request that the diner must confirm on WhatsApp from the same phone number before the restaurant sees it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key and same body within 24 hours returns the same booking (with a new status token).

parameters.name: Poppy-Session
parameters.description: Accepted and not used: this API is signed out.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later in Hong Kong time.

phone.description: The diner's WhatsApp number in E.164, e.g. +85291234567.

202.description: Awaiting the diner's confirmation on WhatsApp.

400.description: invalid_request: a field is missing or invalid, or an unknown field was sent.

404.description: not_found: this restaurant does not take bookings through agents.

409.description: idempotency_conflict: the Idempotency-Key was used with another body.

parameters.name: X-Booking-Status-Token
parameters.description: The status_token from the create response.

parameters.name: Poppy-Session
parameters.description: Accepted and not used: this API is signed out.

404.description: not_found: unknown booking or wrong token.

confirm_url.description: WhatsApp link to the restaurant with the code prefilled. Give it to the diner.

confirm_code.description: The code the diner sends if they type the message themselves.

status_token.description: Send as X-Booking-Status-Token to read the status. Keep it secret.
